snippet.title: MAKAI CITY CHI-BA – Official Trailer | Coming to Steam Nov 1, 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5410560/

MAKAI CITY CHI-BA is a modern folklore RPG built from the place names, legends, and terrain of Chiba, Japan.
Explore a city where ancient local legends spill into the present day. (3–6 hours of play)

■ Release: November 1, 2026 (planned)
■ Platform: Windows (Steam)
■ Price: $3.99 / ¥600
■ Languages: Japanese, English
■ Genre: RPG

Developer: Koyurugi Kobo (solo developer)
Official site: https://sites.google.com/view/koyurugi-koubou/

#MAKAICITYCHIBA #IndieGame #RPG #RPGMaker #Steam
